title: Provenance
description: Provenance record attached to every context pack and machine-generated artifact. Records source file hashes, schema version, run parameters, and agent ID so any artifact can be reproduced from inputs alone. Satisfies reproducibility requirement: same inputs + seed = bit-identical outputs.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the artifact was generated.

agent_id.description: Agent that produced this artifact (e.g. writer_agent/v1.2.0).

view_schema_version.description: Schema version of the artifact format.

run_seed.description: RNG seed for this pipeline run. Pinned at job start.

source_hashes.description: SHA-256 hashes of every source file that contributed to this artifact. Key = relative file path; value = hex digest. Enables exact reproduction.

model_versions.description: LLM model IDs used during this agent invocation. Key = model role (drafter, critic, reader); value = model ID string.

profile_versions.description: Profile IDs and versions in effect. Key = profile type (author, genre, audience, sensitivity, goal); value = '{profile_id}@{version}'.

source_files.description: Ordered list of source file paths that contributed to this artifact. Mirrors source_hashes keys for human readability.
